note: Gadget rows are joined by name alone (hand table) to reference-data/frosty/gadget-ui-metadata.json; vehicle rows join an L3306 UI record to the blueprint whose file name ends with the record name. A key with @ names the hardware leaf where two entries share a stat id. Vehicle equipment rows are joined by a hand table from stat id to the designation text of vehicle UI records (builds 1.4.3.5); no asset reference links a UI record to an equipment entry.

gad_tugs.category: This device spots nearby moving enemies, vehicles, and gadgets, marking their position in-world and on the minimap for all team members. Enemy infantry can remain undetected while moving in crouch or prone. The device emits a sound audible to hostiles.

gad_vehsupcra.category: A deployable pallet that will resupply and repair friendly vehicles.

gad_ladder.category: Provides access to higher ledges and new points of entry to certain areas.

gad_eodbotmine.category: Remotely controllable robot with various capabilities like mine clearance, gadget disruption, and gadget deployment.

gad_eodbotdemine.category: Remotely controllable robot with various capabilities like mine clearance, gadget disruption, and gadget deployment.

gad_lancet.category: When equipped, the Hardware Suppression System spots all nearby electronic and explosive gadgets as well as targets in the middle of a locked-on process. Take aim and activate the device to intercept missiles and destroy electronic gadgets, up to a total of three combined.

gad_gren_flash.category: Ideal for close-quarters, this grenade emits a blinding blast to visually impair enemies for a short time.

gad_sup_pouch.category: A single-use pouch filled with medical supplies to aid soldiers in resupplying and the tending of wounds.

gad_gasmask.category: A multi-filter respirator that, when equipped, protects the wearer from the disorienting effects of VL-7 smoke.

gad_gren_smoke.category: A grenade equipped with a time fuze that can be used to create smoke screens to hide infantry or for ground signaling.

gad_mpaps.category: Once set on the ground, this device tracks and destroys larger incoming projectiles such as missiles, mortar shells, and tank shells. Can intercept up to three projectiles during a window of activation that begins after the initial detection.

gad_adren.category: A medical device that quickly aids recovery and temporarily enhances combat performance.

gad_deploybeacon.category: This device marks the location as a secure position, allowing soldiers to use it as a deploy point.

gad_sup_bag.category: A deployable bag that provides ammunition and medical supplies.

gad_tdart.category: A gas-powered pistol that fires a magnetic dart for marking enemy vehicles or personnel to assist guided missile attacks.

gad_spdrone.category: Can be placed for use by eliminated squadmates

gad_eodbot.category: Remotely controllable robot with various capabilities like mine clearance, gadget disruption, and gadget deployment.
